The files in this folder are xterm.js and four of its addons by the xterm.js authors,
copied unchanged from their npm packages (the ES module builds lib/*.mjs, renamed .js so
every server sends them as JavaScript; css/xterm.css as is). Apaki loads them only when a
console opens (apaki/ui/console.js). sha256 of each file as copied:
  xterm.js            @xterm/xterm 6.0.0             b336ec65a086c056d4804b3d4c2347da5663d3f23c3f25be866467bd8857ad59
  xterm.css           @xterm/xterm 6.0.0             854a7c0fb70e8b1a083c16797ab827299fb18744f5ad34f227b48337e33293c6
  addon-fit.js        @xterm/addon-fit 0.11.0        2d87e1bddc73be9111de8beee5370c3bb7aac9c94e18e6f245f02ca741ef1769
  addon-web-links.js  @xterm/addon-web-links 0.12.0  cce9cc1905c4d369dfa70ef0ed1eea12700754818a6c480d1fd94895dddd1a25
  addon-unicode11.js  @xterm/addon-unicode11 0.9.0   37bb2d573c615661c875398be2a3497e02bd21d7202a5d1159f6ab70a8cfc2f2
  addon-webgl.js      @xterm/addon-webgl 0.19.0      5ac2cbbb8a861ba99176eda0ee91f10c08de32d091e3488edf699ad111131ebb
Source: https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js
